receipts.hypothesis: XGBoost regularized boosting may expose probability shape, signal density, and validation/OOS preservation behavior that differs from prior LogReg, LightGBM, ExtraTrees, MLP, SVM, LDA, and QDA probes.
receipts.baseline: No trading baseline. Compare only against the fixed v2 data/label/split/model-input contracts and preserved clues from closed stages.
receipts.decision_use: Decide whether Stage17 should proceed to broad XGBoost structural scout, WFO, or MT5 runtime_probe after the first evidence packet.
receipts.comparison_baseline: No trading baseline. Compare only against the fixed v2 data/label/split/model-input contracts and preserved clues from closed stages.
receipts.sample_scope: Stage04 audited 58-feature model input and Stage03 training label/split contract.
receipts.success_criteria: Tier A, Tier B, and Tier A+B combined views show enough repeated validation/OOS signal behavior to justify a next run.
receipts.failure_criteria: Validation-only or OOS-only spikes, too-thin signals, or direct repeats of LightGBM/ExtraTrees failure structure.
invalid_conditions: Treating Stage10/11/12/16 thresholds or context gates as a baseline
Omitting Tier B or combined records
Claiming alpha quality, edge, promotion, runtime authority, or selected baseline before evidence exists
stop_conditions: Do not micro-tune before a broad sweep
Stop at topic open if state sync fails
evidence_plan: Stage17 stage brief and input references
run11A manifest and prediction tables when executed
Stage and project ledgers when runs exist
State sync audit for topic-open state

receipts.exploration_lane: Stage17 independent XGBoost regularized boosting model-family exploration design.
receipts.hypothesis: XGBoost regularized boosting can reveal different probability and signal-density behavior from previously closed model-family topics.
receipts.idea_boundary: topic pivot open; no baseline, model artifact, run result, or operating selection.
receipts.broad_sweep: Regularization, depth, learning rate, and subsampling ranges before any micro-search.
receipts.extreme_sweep: Include shallow/regularized and deeper/less-regularized boundary variants if the first structural scout proceeds.
receipts.micro_search_gate: Only micro-tune after multiple adjacent settings preserve validation/OOS behavior.
receipts.wfo_plan: Use WFO as the default robustness frame after a coarse scout produces a candidate surface.
receipts.failure_memory: Record validation-only spikes, OOS-only spikes, thin signals, and LightGBM/ExtraTrees-like failure as reusable negative memory.
receipts.negative_memory_effect: Future failures are recorded as reusable evidence and should prevent repeating LightGBM/ExtraTrees-like dead ends.
receipts.operating_claim_boundary: No alpha quality, edge, promotion candidate, operating promotion, runtime authority, or selected baseline.

receipts.hashes_or_missing_reasons: No model, ONNX, MT5, or run artifact exists yet because Stage17 was only opened as a topic.
receipts.lineage_boundary: stage topic-open lineage only; no runtime or trading-result claim.

receipts.environment_assumptions: Windows PowerShell workspace on branch codex/stage17; xgboost, lightgbm, and sklearn imports are available in the current Python environment.
receipts.dependency_or_runtime_surface: No new dependency, model training, or MT5 runtime run was introduced by the stage topic open.
receipts.clean_checkout_boundary: Stage17 XGBoost scaffold is tracked text evidence and can be reproduced from git.
receipts.reproducibility_gaps: First XGBoost run has not been executed, so model artifact reproducibility remains future work.
